item.title: Shepherd's Hope receives $10k in grant
item.description: UCF Lake Nona Hospital gifted the faith-based nonprofit $10,000 to support its Heart-to-Heart initiative.

item.title: Caribbean Sunshine Eatery’s outdoor patio catches fire
item.description: The fire at the Winter Garden restaurant occurred Wednesday, Feb. 25.

item.title: Healthy West Orange Arts and Heritage Center looking for submissions
item.description: The call for art is for the center's "Color Speaks" exhibit.

item.title: Soccer stadium no longer planned for Winter Garden
item.description: The developer notified the city that the property owner was not proceeding with the proposal, and the property now is up for sale..

item.title: Reclaimed water only available intermittently in the city of Winter Garden
item.description: The interruption in service is due to the construction on the new Wastewater Treatment Plant.

item.title: Ocoee police search for man who ran from officers
item.description: The Ocoee Police Department is searching for a man who ran on foot after officers attempted to conduct a traffic stop the night of Wednesday, Feb. 25.

item.title: Three Birds Cafe officially closes doors
item.description: Three Birds Express now will be a vendor at Crooked Can Brewing Co.'s Minneola location.

item.title: Savannah's 5K raises more than $15k
item.description: Savannah Emery, 14, suffers from leukemia. Her family held a 5K to raise leukemia awareness.

item.title: Applications are open for Ocoee's Neighborhood Improvement Grant
item.description: Ocoee is offering funds to help residents improve their neighborhoods.

item.title: Matthew's Hope in need of volunteers
item.description: The ministry asks for volunteers to help sort and separate donations on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, as well as a helping hand for its Laundry Team on Tuesdays.
